body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Beone CNR has presented its premium packing materials designed for Samsung Giorgio Armani phone(model: SCH-W820/SPH-W8200) during CES 2010.

Beone CNR is a medium-sized company that has developed and produced about 400 kinds of mobile phone packing together with the wireless business department of Samsung Electronics. The packings of Samsung slim phone and Armani phone were selected by the Korea Institute of Design Promotion as a 'Good Design Award'.

CEO Hyun Yong-Uk of Beone CNR said, "Our premium packing materials are now shipping for Samsung Electronics as well as Plantronics", "We will hit the U.S market to increase export rate of premium packing materials from 3% up to 15%," he continued.

On the other hand, Beone CNR is developing packing materials that make the product images stand out by developing a higher level of design and paper materials instead of just focusing on protecting the products.

Especially the company is developing 'papier-mache structure' packing materials, and is improving productivity by doing away with the plastic tray inside and developing only with an eco-friendly paper structure.
